H.description: Hydrogen — atomic hydrogen, 1S/2S/2P/... bound-state QED precision data

2P3/2-2P1/2._note: Hagley-Pipkin 1994 Phys. Rev. Lett. 72, 1172. Canonical precision-spectroscopy extraction of the 2P fine-structure interval via direct 2P_3/2 - 2S_1/2 RF spectroscopy at 9911.117(40) MHz combined with the Lamb shift. The 10969.13(10) MHz value seeded here matches the value transcribed in nist.list_dirac_targets and 10_CrossComparison.md's measurement column. Specific digits should be verified against the published paper before human_reviewed: true.

values._note: CODATA-2018 global adjustment. Combines experimental measurements with one-loop QED theoretical inputs.

Lundeen-Pipkin 1981 Phys. Rev. Lett. 46, 232. Direct microwave-RF measurement of the 2S_1/2-2P_1/2 splitting at ~10 kHz precision; the canonical direct experimental Lamb shift. The numerical value matches the CODATA-2018 average above (the agreement is by historical construction — CODATA uses this measurement as input). Both surfaced per umbrella §5 disagreement-representation rule: consumers choosing the experimental anchor for model verification should use this one (safe_for_model_verification: True), not the CODATA one.

1s2S1/2._note: 21-cm hydrogen hyperfine line, Essen et al. 1957 maser measurement; later refinements push uncertainty to sub-mHz.

2s2S1/2._note: H 2S_1/2 hyperfine splitting; the value the Gill 'Analytic Representation of The Dirac Equation' paper cites (line 257) as 0.177566850(10) GHz sourced from Mizushima's 1970 textbook (which transcribes Heberle-Reich-Kusch 1956 Phys. Rev. 101, 612 and subsequent refinements). The scaling 177.5/1420.4 ~ 1/8 reflects the standard wavefunction-density factor between 1S and 2S hyperfine. More recent precision measurement: Kolachevsky-Khabarova-Berkeland-Hänsch 2009 Phys. Rev. A 79, 062505 at 177.5568343(67) MHz. Specific digits should be verified against the published paper before human_reviewed: true.

1S-2S._note: Parthey-Matveev-Alnis-Bernhardt-Beyer-Hansch et al. 2011 absolute frequency measurement of the H 1S-2S two-photon transition; ~4e-15 fractional uncertainty.

1S-2S_H-D_isotope_shift._note: Parthey-Matveev-Alnis-Pohl-Udem-Holzwarth-Hansch 2010 Phys. Rev. Lett. 104, 233001. H 1S-2S minus D 1S-2S; constrains the proton-deuteron charge-radius difference. Specific digits should be verified against the published paper.

1S-3S._note: Fleurbaey-Galtier-Thomas-Bonnaud-Julien-Biraben-Nez-Abgrall-Guena 2018 Phys. Rev. Lett. 120, 183001. H 1S-3S two-photon spectroscopy at LKB; consistent with muonic-H proton-radius value (contradicts pre-puzzle CODATA average). Specific digits should be verified against the published paper.

2S-4P1/2._note: Beyer-Maisenbacher-Khabarova-Yost-Matveev-Pohl-Hansch et al. 2017 Science 358, 79. H 2S_1/2-4P_1/2 transition measured at MPQ; also yields the proton charge radius consistent with the muonic-H value. Specific digits should be verified against the published paper; companion 2S-4P3/2 transition deferred to follow-up.

2S-8S1/2._note: de Beauvoir-Schwob-Acef-Jozefowski-Hilico-Nez-Julien-Clairon-Biraben 1997 Phys. Rev. Lett. 78, 440 (and Eur. Phys. J. D 1, 227, 1998). H 2S-8S/8D two-photon spectroscopy at LKB, foundational for the Rydberg-constant determination. Listed entry is 2S_1/2-8S_1/2; the 8D transitions exist in the same measurement set and should be added in a follow-up. Specific digits should be verified against the published paper.

muonic_H.description: Muonic hydrogen — bound state of proton + muon (replaces electron with muon)

2S1/2-2P3/2._note: Pohl et al. 2010 Nature 466, 213. Direct muonic-hydrogen Lamb-shift measurement; triggered the proton-radius puzzle (rp ~ 0.84 fm).

muonium.description: Muonium — bound state of mu+ and e- (electron orbiting an anti-muon, no nucleus)

1s2S1/2._note: Liu et al. 1999 Phys. Rev. Lett. 82, 711. Muonium ground-state hyperfine interval; benchmark test of bound-state QED free of nuclear-structure uncertainties.

positronium.description: Positronium — bound state of e+ and e- (pure leptonic, no hadronic uncertainties)

1s_ortho_para._note: Ishida-Suehara-Namba et al. 2014 measurement at ~10 ppm.

Si XIV.description: Hydrogenic silicon ion (Si^13+, one electron bound to Z=14 nucleus). Z-scan target of issue #82.

1s2S1/2._note: Sturm et al. 2011 Phys. Rev. Lett. 107, 023002 (NOTE: paper year is 2011, not 2013; cite_key mislabels the year). Measured g = 1.9953489587(5)(3)(8). RESOURCED 2026-06-01 (refs #119): prior seed 1.9953395931 was wrong by ~9.4e-6 (~1.6e4 sigma).

Li III.description: Hydrogenic lithium ion (Li^2+, one electron bound to Z=3 nucleus). Issue #78 + #82 target.

1s2S1/2._note: PROVENANCE UNVERIFIED. No confirmed direct measurement of the 7Li2+ 1s hyperfine splitting was found (literature gives Li+ two-electron HFS and predicts Li2+ from it); the prior beckert2007 citation resolved to a condensed-matter paper. Downgraded to theoretical_calculation 2026-06-01 (refs #119) so it is not used as an experimental anchor. Value retained pending human re-sourcing -- verify.

2S1/2-2P1/2._note: 6Li2+ n=2 Lamb shift (2S1/2->2P1/2) = 62765(21) MHz, Phys. Rev. Lett. 32, 808 (1974) / Phys. Rev. A 11, 427 (1975), microwave-optical trapping technique. RESOURCED 2026-06-01 (refs #119): value retained (it is correct) but the prior citation 'Schiffer 1995 PRL 74, 2188' was WRONG -- that reference is a La3+ giant dipole resonance paper. Confirm primary-source authors before human_reviewed.

2P3/2-2P1/2._note: NO precision measurement of the hydrogenic Li2+ (Z=3) 2P3/2-2P1/2 fine-structure interval found. Value is the leading-order Z^4 Dirac estimate (H 10969.13 MHz x 3^4 = 888500 MHz); QED/higher-order corrections ~1%% not included. Use as a theory comparator only. RESOURCED 2026-06-01 (refs #119): prior seed 7367 MHz was ~120x too small -- it was a Li+ (two-electron) 2^3P interval from Riis 1994 PRA 49,207, misattributed to hydrogenic Li2+. THEORY VALUE INSERTED BY AI -- human to verify.

1s2S1/2._note: NO direct high-precision measurement of the hydrogenic Li2+ (Z=3) bound-electron g-factor is known (the measured hydrogenic sequence is 3He+, C5+, O7+, Si13+, Ca19+/20+, Sn49+, Pb81+). Value is the LEADING-ORDER theoretical estimate g = (2/3)[1+2 sqrt(1-(Zalpha)^2)] + 2 a_e (Breit + Schwinger anomaly); higher-order bound-state QED ~1e-7 not included. Use as a theory comparator only. RESOURCED 2026-06-01 (refs #119): prior seed 2.0000251707 was physically impossible and cited a cancer-biology paper. THEORY VALUE INSERTED BY AI -- human to verify.

Be IV.description: Hydrogenic beryllium ion (Be^3+, one electron bound to Z=4 nucleus). Issue #82 Z-scan target.

1s2S1/2._note: NO precision measurement of the hydrogenic Be3+ (Z=4) bound-electron g-factor found as of 2026-06. Value is the leading-order theoretical estimate g = (2/3)[1+2 sqrt(1-(Zalpha)^2)] + 2 a_e. Use as a theory comparator only. RESOURCED 2026-06-01 (refs #119): prior seed 2.00001769 was physically impossible and cited a lithium-like-calcium paper. THEORY VALUE INSERTED BY AI -- human to verify.

C VI.description: Hydrogenic carbon ion (C^5+, one electron bound to Z=6 nucleus). Issue #82 Z-scan target.

1s2S1/2._note: Häffner-Beier-Hermanspahn-Kluge-Quint-Stahl-Verdú-Werth 2000 Phys. Rev. Lett. 85, 5308. First precision Penning-trap measurement of the hydrogenic C^5+ bound-electron g-factor; the canonical reference for the carbon point in the Z-scan series of #82. Modern refinements (Köhler 2016) exist but the Häffner 2000 measurement remains the canonical first-precision value. Specific digits should be verified against the published paper.

He II.description: Hydrogenic helium ion (He+, one electron bound to Z=2 nucleus).

1s2S1/2._note: Schneider et al. 2022, Nature 606, 878-883, DOI 10.1038/s41586-022-04761-7 (arXiv:2206.05943). Measured 3He+ bound-electron g-factor g_e = -2.00217741579(34)_stat(30)_sys; magnitude recorded here. RESOURCED 2026-06-01 (refs #119): prior seed 1.999985794 was physically impossible (~2.2e6 sigma off the Breit value) and cited a lithium-like-calcium paper.
